name: workflow_start
description: Start a new workflow instance in z-camuda (Camunda BPMN engine). Use this when the CEO agent needs to kick off a business process: a 5-look evaluation for a new opportunity, a deployment approval, a product launch gate, etc. The process is identified by `processCode` (e.g. '5-look-evaluation', 'deployment-approval'). Pass initial variables as a JSON object — these flow through the BPMN as process variables. Returns the new process instance id and the first task id. Requires z-ctc 'workflow:execute' permission (FEATURE025).

processCode.description: BPMN process definition key. Must be deployed first (see z-camuda/z-camuda-starter/src/main/resources/processes/). Common values: '5-look-evaluation' (FEATURE024), 'deployment-approval' (FEATURE031), 'product-launch' (FEATURE032).

businessKey.description: Optional business identifier for traceability. e.g. 'OPP-007' for opportunity #7, or 'release/v1.2.0' for a release.

variables.description: Initial process variables as JSON. Each key becomes a process variable available to all tasks. e.g. {"opportunityId":"OPP-007","marketScore":4.5,"competitorScore":3.2}.

starter.description: Username of who is starting the process (for audit). e.g. 'ceo-agent' or 'zifang'.
